title: genieai-common library chart values
description: Descriptive schema for the library's naming knobs. NOTE on scope: the helpers read these keys from the CONSUMING chart's root values (nameOverride, fullnameOverride, component at the top level), because template definitions render with the parent's context. Setting them under the `genieai-common:` dependency subtree is validated here but silently ignored — always set them at the root of the consuming chart's values.

global.description: Helm-injected subtree every chart receives from the root release values. Defined here only so additionalProperties:false tolerates the key Helm always injects; the library itself reads nothing from it.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name segment in resource names. Empty = use chart default.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the entire resource name prefix. Empty = use <release>-<chart>.

component.description: Free-form string identifying the component of a resource; consumed by genieai-common.labels to emit genieai.io/component: <component>. No enum — callers pick the value. NOTE: top-level additionalProperties is false, but `component` is in the known property set (no error at render time).
